name: feature-impl
description: TDD Feature Implementation Workflow with GitHub Integration - Orchestrates parallel development using specialized agents, GitHub Issues tracking, and Red-Green-Refactor methodology
author: feature-impl team

requirements.git: Required - must be a git repository with remote configured
requirements.gh_cli: Required - GitHub CLI must be installed and authenticated
requirements.node: Optional - for running tests and builds

notes: This skill requires GitHub integration and will create/manage GitHub Issues
All work is tracked via feature branches (feature/{feature-name})
Techspec files can be placed at docs/features/{feature}/techspec.md or specified by user
Supports case-insensitive techspec naming: techspec.md, tech-spec.md, tech_spec.md, spec.md
Progress is dual-tracked: TODO.md (local fast view) + GitHub Issues (source of truth)
Estimated 60% time savings via parallel agent execution
